annotations.title: Get a human on the line

description: A crew member dials the number, works the phone menu, hold and AI receptionist until a real person answers, then connects the key's owner into the live call. Spends credits ($0.30 per crew minute; no extra charge when a person is reached). Company lines only unless the callee gave written consent.
